poc_summary: Scope: Evaluate Redwood Dedicated for 2-week soak + targeted load tests to validate throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for production trader workflows. Representative workload: mix of short chat queries (avg 40 tokens), medium reranking (avg 120 tokens, top-k=16), and long-context summarization (avg 1,500 tokens chunking). Targets: sustained 200-250 req/sec for mixed workload with p50 < 20ms token latency, p95 <= 120ms end-to-end, p99 <= 250ms. Reserved GPU planning: baseline proposal = 8 x A100 80GB (model variants: 70B quantized + 13B low-latency fallback). Tests: ramp tests to 300 rps, 14-day soak at 70% rated CPU/GPU utilization, nightly stress windows, KV cache warm/cold runs. Success criteria: meet p95 SLA 95% of windows during soak, maintain model quality within 2% of baseline eval metrics, and validate autoscaling/fallback transitions without >500ms+ spike events.
